subject: INGETRANS Smart product evolution
goal: Define a rail-less evolution of INGETRANS based on the Modulo Smart Weels drive and steering technology while preserving the product's corrugated reel logistics value proposition.
product_boundary: For this definition, INGETRANS Smart is scoped as a corrugated reel supply-and-return product, not as a generic intralogistics platform for every load type.

validated_baseline_claims.statement: Current INGETRANS is described as a turnkey rail-guided intralogistics system for automated transport, delivery and return of paper reels between warehouse exchange area and corrugator consumption points.
Current INGETRANS value proposition is to reduce forklift dependency, improve safety, synchronize reel supply with production and preserve reel identity during return flow.
Legacy public references describe a transfer carriage speed of 80 m/min, track speed of 59 m/min, approximately 4.5 s acceleration ramp and approximately 6 s pick-up/drop-off interfaces.

validated_smart_weels_module_claims.statement: The Modulo Smart Weels modular drive system can be attached directly to new or existing frames and cover loads from 1 to 60 tons through different wheel combinations.

The Modulo Smart Weels drive and steering module uses two independent drive wheels, differential steering, a single hybrid power and signal connector and brushless motors to combine traction, compactness and low-friction direction changes.

For the Smart Weels 4TP reference, published values include 4,000 kg carrying capacity, 4,000 kg towed load capacity, speed from 1 mm/s to 2 km/h, 3% slope, polyurethane tire, IP54, and nominal service life of 2,500 km or 10,000 operating hours.

Standard operating modes include crab mode, car mode and autorotation, with optional semi-automatic line tracking using optical guidance sensors, painted or DataMatrix lines and external PLC coordination over EtherNet/IP or PROFINET on request.
Safety functions include Safety Stop 1 at PLd level, STO, safety brakes, remote emergency stop, loss-of-radio stop behavior and optional external safety sensor inputs.

The Modulo Smart Weels installation is designed as fast and low-adjustment, with plate mounting, quick electrical connection and direct integration on customer frames without fixed rail infrastructure.

PRC-23-099 was issued to MTORRES on 2023-08-09 with one-month validity; MDS-2x4TP list price was 40,894 EUR (qty 1) and 31,187 EUR per unit (qty 10); complete kit with batteries, remote and foot guards 45,803 EUR (qty 1).

Semi-automatic line-following requires an optical sensor per DDW (5,496 EUR each, LIC-0002 included); path generation and fleet scheduling are excluded from the JNOV supply and must be coded in the JNOV PLC or the customer master PLC.
Lead time is T0+24 weeks for delivery and T0+26 weeks for commissioning; supply is EXW Pujaudran with 24-month warranty (12 months for batteries).

Floor requirements: concrete or asphalt, DIN 18202 table 3 line 3 flatness (4 mm/1 m, 10 mm/4 m), slope 3%, ground contact pressure above 10 N/mm2; auxiliary castors must carry less than 50% of total mass with rolling resistance at or below 1.5%.

Supervision or command by a customer PLC over EtherNet/IP (PROFINET on request) exposes operating mode, battery level, current movement and active fault number, and accepts speed and direction setpoints.
JNOV 2023 roadmap lists assisted navigation for MDS, multi-MDS assembly-line use and an AGV MDS milestone for 2024-2025; free autonomous navigation was not available in 2023.

evolution_hypotheses.statement: INGETRANS Smart can preserve the core function of automated reel delivery and return while removing fixed rails by mounting Modulo Smart Weels modules under a custom INGECART reel carrier frame.

The most defensible first product version is rail-less and reconfigurable, but not marketed as full free-navigation autonomy unless additional navigation sensors and validated fleet logic are specified.
A three-level offer is technically coherent: Smart Manual, Smart Guided, and Smart Orchestrated, each adding more route intelligence without changing the base carrier architecture.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: Legacy reel envelope references differ between internal sources.
contradictions_and_limits.detail: Public product pages cite up to 1,800 mm reel length and below 3,500 kg, while one internal engineering basis mentions up to 2,800 mm width/length subject to reel matrix.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Use final approved reel matrix as governing design basis and avoid a single unconditional length claim in the Smart dossier.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: The reference module documentation supports rail-less mobility and semi-automatic guidance, but not unrestricted SLAM-based AGV autonomy.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Position Ingetrans Smart as a rail-less intelligent mobile platform with configurable guidance and PLC orchestration, not as free-navigation AGV unless separately validated.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: The mobility-module certification applies to the supplied wheel and cabinet subsystem, not automatically to the complete INGECART customer machine.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: State that complete CE/risk assessment remains part of final machine engineering and site integration.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: Maximum speed differs between sources: 2 km/h in PRC-23-099 versus 2.5 km/h in the 2023 overview.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Use 2 km/h as the contractual DDW-4TP value; treat 2.5 km/h as range-level marketing data.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: All pricing evidence comes from a 2023 offer addressed to MTORRES whose validity expired.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Flag prices as historical reference in ASE and request an INGECART-specific quotation before any commercial use.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: Battery autonomy is stated as 1000 m per battery without load, floor or duty-cycle conditions.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Require an autonomy-versus-load curve in the new quotation and size one battery per DDW plus reserve.

contradictions_and_limits.issue: Path generation and fleet management are outside the JNOV supply.
contradictions_and_limits.resolution: Define them as INGECART master PLC / WCS scope for Smart Guided and Smart Orchestrated.

known: Current INGETRANS baseline function and public positioning are clear.
The Modulo Smart Weels technology provides a credible rail-less mobility basis.
The strongest Smart value proposition is installation simplification plus route flexibility while preserving supply/return automation.
JNOV commercial structure (base kit, semi-auto option, PLC interface option, services, lead time) is documented from PRC-23-099 and the 2023 overview.
partially_confirmed: Final Smart payload architecture for corrugated reels depends on chosen frame geometry, number of wheels, center of gravity and floor conditions.
Full throughput delta versus rail-guided INGETRANS requires a dedicated cycle-time and route-conflict model.
missing: Final reel-carrier mechanical concept, including cradle geometry and load distribution.
Approved navigation concept per customer segment: manual only, line-guided or external PLC/fleet orchestrated.
Final safety architecture for complete customer machine.
Commercial target price and installed ROI model for Smart.
next_actions: Request an updated JNOV TECH quotation addressed to INGECART for MDS-2x4TP and MDS-2x4TL including LIC-0002, PLC supervision and autonomy curve.
Design a reference Smart carrier with mass breakdown and wheel loading.
Simulate request-to-delivery times for Smart versus rail-guided INGETRANS on 2-3 reference layouts.
Define a standard controls stack for WCS, ERP/MES/WMS and external PLC integration.
Prepare EN/ES public solution pages once the product architecture is approved.
Register the INGETRANS Smart variant in ASE with the three cost bands marked as 2023 historical reference.
